title: Remove redundant Callout import from plugin-calendar-view.mdx
body:
Build was failing with module resolution error:
```
Module not found: Can't resolve 'fumadocs-ui/components/callout'
```

## Changes

- Removed explicit `import { Callout } from 'fumadocs-ui/components/callout'` from `content/docs/plugins/plugin-calendar-view.mdx`

The `Callout` component is already available globally via `defaultMdxComponents` configured in `apps/site/mdx-components.tsx`. The explicit import was unnecessary and causing module resolution issues during Next.js/Turbopack build.

```diff
-import { Callout } from 'fumadocs-ui/components/callout';
-
 <Callout type="info" title="Merged into Plugin Calendar">
```

Component usage remains unchanged—it's provided through the MDX components context.
